title: CCMP: Class-Conditional Multicollinearity Pruning for High-Dimensional Feature Selection
abstract: arXiv:2511.12451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In high-dimensional scientific measurements, many features in a single sample often capture the same underlying physical attributes, producing severe multicollinearity. Supervised feature selectors fit on the entire dataset, so a feature can be informative for classification overall while still redundant with another feature in the same class. Class-conditional selectors, by contrast, trade some accuracy for a narrower, per-class view, since they never see data outside one class, but this lets new classes be added without refitting the whole model. They still cannot determine, however, which feature to drop from a correlated group. To close this gap, we propose classconditional multicollinearity pruning (CCMP), which iteratively prunes one feature from every highly correlated pair, per class. translated_title: CCMP：面向高维特征选择的类条件多重共线性剪枝
translated_abstract: 在高维科学测量中，单个样本内的许多特征往往捕捉的是相同的底层物理属性，从而产生严重的多重共线性。监督式特征选择器在整个数据集上拟合，因此某个特征可能在整体上对分类具有信息量，但在同一类别内仍与另一个特征冗余。相比之下，类条件选择器以牺牲部分准确性为代价换取更窄的逐类视角，因为它们从不接触单个类别之外的数据，但这使得可以在不重新拟合整个模型的情况下添加新类别。然而，它们仍然无法确定应从相关特征组中删除哪个特征。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了类条件多重共线性剪枝（CCMP），它按类别迭代地从每个高度相关的特征对中剪除一个特征。四个理论保证在给定假设下为剪枝所引起的误差建立了明确的界限。在四个基准数据集上（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出类条件多重共线性剪枝方法CCMP，按类别迭代地从高度相关特征对中剪除冗余特征，并给出剪枝误差的明确理论界限，从而实现无需整体重拟合的高维特征选择。
en_tdlr: CCMP iteratively prunes one feature from each highly correlated pair on a per-class basis for high-dimensional feature selection, supported by four theoretical guarantees that explicitly bound the error induced by pruning.
